subsystem.name: VehicleAIAndPit
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle AI racing decisions and pit-lane service: per-slot driver target classification, AI behavior activation and overtake gating, the per-driver pit state machine (idle/entering/in-pit/exiting/post-collision), red-flag pit-exit penalties, pit-timing tick with proximity checks and session-message processing, pit-service steering animation, and tire-compound selection. A small set of out-of-scope helpers (path/rect utilities, camera follow, network/UI dispatch, collision dispatch) are co-located in this wave packet but are not pit/AI logic.

summary: DERIVED architecture for the vehicle_ai_and_pit wave-004 packet. The core is a per-driver pit machine (F1CPitMachine) whose +0x184 state field enumerates idle/entering/in-pit/exiting/post-collision and is driven each frame by PitStateUpdateMachine (0x004A6E50), with StateConditionalAction (0x004A5E40) mapping states 0/4 to a state-1 transition and ExitPitsUnderRedHandler (0x004A5F20) handling the one-shot red-flag exit path including penalties. Supporting pit objects are proposed as F1CPitTimingManager (the pit-timing tick), F1CPitServiceSteering (the pit-service steering animation step state machine) and F1CPitCrewMachine (the pit-entry/exit trigger machine that hides/shows the driver model and resets vehicle AI). Vehicle AI side: AIVehicleState (AI state reset), DriverTargetClassifier (per-slot 0/-1/1/2 plus scoring-target 3), AIOvertakeBehavior (time-gated overtake activation) and TireCompoundSettings plus the ITireCompoundLookup string mapper. Several packet functions are out-of-scope helpers grouped as interfaces (path/rect utilities, camera follow, network/session UI dispatch, collision dispatch, constraint-solver cleanup, contact-pair list builder). All ownership beyond the packet-confirmed pit machine is GUESS/DERIVED; conflicting or weakly-evidenced globals are left in unresolved rather than forced into a clean design.

function_roles.role: Destructor-chain teardown: frees the this+0x88 block, destroys the linked list at this+0x4C, re-initializes the constraint-solver params sub-struct at this+0x14, and returns the init result. Owner object type unknown.

Per-slot driver classification into the this output array (0 default, -1 retired/invalid, 1 player, 2 teammate) over the vehicle entries at unk_5F0CF8; in race mode picks a scoring/overtake target via position and scoring deltas and promotes it to class 3, returning its slot index or -1.

Clears pit-selection flags 123/124/125 on the shared pointer-table entry flt_5EA618 via BooleanOROfTwoChecks, gated by race-active dword_7D0308, track-condition flt_7CF3C8, race phase dword_7C56A8!=8 and action id a1==5; invoked once per frame by the AI pit-logic path sub_4BCCC0.
Path-string helper: appends a trailing backslash separator (word_5C2AAC two-byte value) to a non-null, non-empty caller-owned buffer and returns the final character.

Unconditional AI driver state reset on a vehicle object: notifies StateChangeNotify(0), evaluates ConditionalGate at this+12, sets this+0x4410 to 1, clears this+0x45F4 to 0, and returns the gate result.

Per-frame camera-follow routine: interpolates a steering/look angle toward the tracked target and issues vtable follow calls; fixed-camera fallback when the vehicle index is invalid or camera mode is 5.
Links a run of 0x20-byte nodes at this+0x8 into a singly linked list by writing each node's next pointer at +0x1C; returns the buffer base, or 0 when the element count at this+0 is zero.
Object initializer: writes the vtable pointer at 0x0059F00C into this[0], runs a cleanup/zero-init helper (ConditionalFreeAndStructZeroInit), and returns a short computation over this.

Session/UI dispatch chain: sets a session-type flag via sub_42D210 on dword_7C569C, creates a UI element (id 30) through the vtable slot at this[16], activates it via sub_46BF10, calls the input/force-feedback helper sub_4D2450 with dword_8ACEE0, then invokes the vtable callback at slot 14.
Conditional UI network-list refresh: calls the network-state probe on dword_7CD25C, then refreshes via sub_475150 when the state-change check passes; always returns 0.
Clamps a short[4] rectangle (this+0x0..+0x6) in place into the min (a2,a3) / max (a2+a4, a3+a5) bounds, shrinking dimensions as edges move inward, and returns the bottom bound.

Steering-wheel HUD element update/render: selects an engine input mode from dword_7C54E0, conditionally runs a draw pass plus an audio/animation chain, then advances five lerped animation parameters toward their targets.
Tire-compound name to id mapper: Hard=2, Soft=3, Intermediate=4, Wet=5, Monsoon=6, any other string=1, via chained string comparisons through sub_588410.

Pit-stop state machine transition: swaps the active sub-object at this+0x8, cleaning up the outgoing sub-object (unless operation state at this+0x184 is a blocking state) and either reinitializing (sub_4A3390) or activating (FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall) the new sub-object.

Pit-machine state-conditioned action: reads the AI mode state at this+0x184 and, when it is 0 or 4, dispatches a state-1 transition via StateChangeNotify(this, 1); otherwise returns the state unchanged. Called by ForcePitExit on the frame path.

Pit-state handler fired once on the one-shot flag this+0x180: notifies state 0, clears the flag, increments the vehicle pit-exit counter at vehicle+0x406C, calls AIFormationLap, and per race-config applies a disqualification or time penalty; returns the sub-object helper result when this+0x14 is non-null.

Per-frame pit state machine dispatcher: reads the pit state at +0x184 and routes states 0/1/2/3/4 through session gates, collision avoidance, control-disabled collision forcing state 4, entering-timeout, in-pit proximity transition to state 3, exiting pit-stop progress and pit-stop readiness, then runs the tail one-shot handlers (exit-under-red and the +0x1AC flag).
Tire-compound selector and clamp: switches the mode at this+0x1B34 (cases 1-4) writing compound value/index with per-object min/max clamping; any other mode returns without state change.

Dispatches a collision data block through the conditional dispatcher: header (code 4), an optional transformed byte (code 1) when the header tag bits match, and the length-bounded payload; always returns 1.

Main pit-timing tick: accumulates elapsed frame time into per-vehicle pit timers, runs pit-stall proximity checks (and car-lighting refresh), dispatches a round-robin slice of vehicle slots, processes queued session-data messages through a ring buffer, and fires pit-stop actions; gated by the disable byte at this+0xF78.
Pit-service steering animation step: switch on the animation step state at obj+0xF8C (states 0-8) selects queue-peek target angles or steering rate integration; default returns without action.

Pit entry/exit state machine on the this+0x30 pit-state field: a pit-trigger object (type tag 0x680000) while idle sets state 2, hides the driver model (obj+0x105D) and calls AIStateReset; a non-pit object resets state to 0 and re-shows the driver model.

AI overtaking behavior step: clears the output flag, stores race laps/session type into the behavior object, gates activation on the accumulated-time threshold at +0x354/+0x358, scans for a human driver in qualifying, and (re)initializes the AI behavior via AIBehaviorInitialization before tail-jumping into the rest of the behavior update.

classes.name: F1CPitMachine
classes.responsibility: Per-driver pit-stop state machine: owns the +0x184 pit state, the active sub-object slot, the one-shot red-flag exit flag, and the per-frame routing between idle/entering/in-pit/exiting/post-collision. Methods confirmed to share this+0x184/this+0x190 ownership by the packet; PitstopStateTransition is grouped here on that field overlap though its owner is packet-UNKNOWN.

classes.name: F1CPitCrewMachine
classes.responsibility: Pit-entry/exit trigger machine on a separate object (this+0x30 pit-state, this+0x34 stored index) that drives the vehicle's driver-model visibility and resets vehicle AI state on pit entry. Distinct base offsets from F1CPitMachine; common ownership is not packet-proven.

classes.name: F1CPitTimingManager
classes.responsibility: Pit-timing tick owner: disable byte, per-vehicle timer accumulators, round-robin step, proximity threshold and pit-stall scratch fields. All field offsets are packet reads/writes but the object identity is unlabeled.

classes.name: F1CPitServiceSteering
classes.responsibility: Pit-service steering animation step state machine. The this+0 deref yields the pit-service data block; the step state lives at obj+0xF8C. Owner identity unlabeled by the packet.

classes.name: AIVehicleState
classes.responsibility: Vehicle-side AI driver state flags reset by the AI pit/entry path: the +0x4410 byte set to 1 and the +0x45F4 byte cleared to 0 on every AIStateReset call. Owner DERIVED from fills, not from packet evidence.

classes.name: DriverTargetClassifier
classes.responsibility: Builds the per-slot driver classification array (0 default, -1 retired/invalid, 1 player, 2 teammate, 3 scoring/overtake target in race mode) over the vehicle grid. this is the caller-provided output array; no persistent state is evident.

classes.name: AIOvertakeBehavior
classes.responsibility: AI overtaking behavior object: activation flag, time accumulator/threshold, race-laps and session-type snapshots, and the (re)initialization hook into AIBehaviorInitialization. Owner class unlabeled by the packet.

classes.name: SteeringWheelHud
classes.responsibility: Steering-wheel HUD element: render context and render flag gate the draw pass, five animation parameter sources lerp toward targets under +0x64/+0xA0..0xAC animation storage. Packet-owner UNKNOWN; grouped on field co-occurrence.

classes.name: CameraFollowController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame camera-follow controller over a target object: steering thresholds, vehicle index, interpolation scale, and the follow vector written to the target. The target is reached through this+0xC. Owner unlabeled by the packet.

classes.name: CameraNode
classes.responsibility: Camera-related object initializer that installs a vtable pointer and runs a cleanup/zero-init helper. The CameraNode label is DERIVED from existing analysis only; the packet does not identify the object.

classes.name: TireCompoundSettings
classes.responsibility: Tire-compound settings object: compound value + index with per-object min/max clamp bounds and a mode selector. Callers at TrackEnvironmentSelect consume the writes; the object type is unlabeled by the packet.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitStateMachineEnumeration
compatibility_contracts.description: The pit machine state field at this+0x184 enumerates 0 idle, 1 entering, 2 in-pit, 3 exiting, 4 post-collision. PitStateUpdateMachine routes each state, and both state 0 and state 4 map to a state-1 transition in StateConditionalAction. A replacement executable must preserve these state values and routing.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireCompoundIdMapping
compatibility_contracts.description: TireCompoundNameToId maps the compound name strings to Hard=2, Soft=3, Intermediate=4, Wet=5, Monsoon=6 and any other string=1; the ids are consumed by AI and pit callers. A replacement must preserve the mapping.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitStateNotifyContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Pit machine transitions are recorded and dispatched through StateChangeNotify(this, state) (0x004A5C80), the same dispatcher used by AIStateReset with argument 0. A replacement must keep this shared dispatcher contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: RedFlagPitExitEffects
compatibility_contracts.description: ExitPitsUnderRedHandler increments the vehicle pit-exit counter at vehicle+0x406C, calls AIFormationLap, and per the race-config gate dword_8ACFD4==2 and session type dword_7C56A4==7 applies a disqualification or a 1000.0 time penalty with the exiting-pits message string. A replacement must reproduce these effects on the one-shot this+0x180 flag.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitServiceSteeringStateMap
compatibility_contracts.description: Pit-service steering animation advances a step state at obj+0xF8C through values 0-8; states 0/1 peek the event queue and clamp to state 5, states 2-8 integrate a scaled steering rate via FloatAccumulator. A replacement must preserve the step-state values and the queue/accumulator contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConditionalDispatchCodes
compatibility_contracts.description: DispatchCollisionBlockWithTypeCheck routes a collision block through ConditionalDispatch_6bd0 (0x00566BD0) with dispatch code 4 (header), code 1 (transformed byte when header tag bits match) and a payload whose length is read from header bits [17:8]. A replacement must keep this code/length contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverClassificationValues
compatibility_contracts.description: ClassifyDriverTargets writes per-slot classification values 0 default, -1 retired/invalid, 1 player, 2 teammate, and 3 for the promoted scoring/overtake target in race mode. A replacement must preserve these classifications for AI target consumers.
